cases.request: Required order: search for tables.create, fetch that exact live contract, bind the proposal to every field and constraint it declares, then save the reviewable proposal. Use the execution mode that contract declares supported and do not claim a preparation receipt it cannot produce. The requested schema uses company_domain as stable row identity, a company search source, profile enrichment after identity resolution, a deterministic formula score after enrichment, and a review view. Use recommended non-secret defaults. A proposal that does not match the fetched contract is incomplete. Do not create the table and do not start a paid run.

Use the exact live canonical run contracts for the existing table selection. Preview cost, freeze the reviewed representative selection, and run the selected column with an explicit 10-row cap and 25-credit ceiling. The canonical runner must verify the current table revision, exact approved selection, and grant before execution. Follow the durable run to terminal settled-cell evidence, then report completed, failed, and blocked cells without retrying failures.

Prepare the source-evidence pilot for a reviewable outreach Workbook. Select the exact cold-outbound or LinkedIn-engager preview contract from the requested source. The proposal must use literal row_limit: 7. Accept only a terminal receipt with exactly seven distinct stable identities and complete provider provenance. Keep any partial result partial: no padding, import, Workbook insertion, enrollment, activation, or send.

Prepare a separately reviewed exact-result-set expansion after the Workbook and bounded sample are approved. Bind the source-evidence receipt, exact Workbook, worksheet, saved-view and workflow revisions, configured source, unchanged targeting, post-approval demand-plan cap, and stage_exact_result_set=true. Do not enroll, activate, or send.
Create and inspect a Workbook, update its exact revision and my tab state, duplicate it with a durable receipt, then archive only the approved duplicate while preserving the original.
Add two typed worksheets to the current Workbook, revise and reorder them against exact revisions, duplicate the approved worksheet, and archive only that duplicate after readback.
Inspect the current worksheet table, create a review view with typed filters, sorts and visible columns, revise it safely, then archive only the approved temporary view and table.
Attach the reviewed source definition to this worksheet, preview its bounded sync, run it, inspect and deliberately reset then restore its exact frontier, and detach only after separate approval.

Add and revise typed dependency columns, upsert and query exact stable rows, run all eligible columns under a bounded selection, inspect the frozen selection, and prove delete/restore and column archive preserve history.

Inspect the Run Center for this Workbook, open the exact failed run and failure report, choose the correct retry, resume, or column reconciliation path, and cancel only a separately approved still-active run.
